Product Overview
These American-style vintage high-waisted wide-leg jeans feature a classic washed finish and distressed details, offering a unique artistic retro appeal. The light blue hue combined with a straight, floor-length cut visually elongates the legs, providing a loose and comfortable wearing experience.

Material: Cotton Denim
Style: Vintage, Artistic Retro
Fit: High Waist, Wide Leg, Straight, Full Length
Features: Washed Distressed Finish, Regular Thickness, Non-elastic
Color: Light Blue
Size: XS, S, M, L, XL
